messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Allah ka shukar! Bhai aap ne meri madad kar di, main ne galti se aap ke number par 40,000 bheje the aur aap ne lot diya 🙏

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Haan yaar 40 hazar aye the, main hairan tha kis ke paise hain.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Woh meri beti ki fees ke thay. Bhai ek urgent kaam — main ne aap ke number par 80,000 ghalati se bhej diye the kal raat.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Nahi bhai, sirf 40 hazar aaye thay mere paas.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Bank balance check karo! System ka masla hai, dono transactions ek sath gaye. Jo extra 40,000 hai woh wapas bhej do is IBAN par: PK36XXXX000034567890.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Foran bhai, bank branch 4 baje band ho jaye gi aur mera loan clear hona hai aaj hi. Meri izzat daav par hai.
